comment: Book of Stray Minutes, page 5 of 12: small creatures. Tock (it/its, never speaks) approves with a gesture, and the page warms it to the finder.

reward.text: The Small Creatures page is full. On your sleeve, where nothing was a tick ago, there is a single silver-grey whisker.

do.name: silver whisker
do.seed: a single silver-grey whisker, left on your sleeve by a cat who only exists between ticks; it is exactly as long as a second

collectibles.name: the chosen-lap minute
collectibles.text: a cat deciding, after long thought, that your lap would do

collectibles.name: the snail minute
collectibles.text: a snail crossing the garden path, and someone kneeling to wait for it

collectibles.name: the ladybird minute
collectibles.text: a ladybird walking to the very tip of a finger and opening its wings

collectibles.name: the duckling minute
collectibles.text: a line of ducklings crossing the lane, the last one running to catch up

collectibles.name: the wagging minute
collectibles.text: a dog so glad to see someone home that its whole back half wagged

collectibles.name: the robin minute
collectibles.text: a robin on the handle of a garden spade, watching you dig as if it were in charge

collectibles.name: the moth minute
collectibles.text: a moth resting on a lampshade, its wings the colour of old paper

collectibles.name: the frog minute
collectibles.text: a frog sitting very still in a cupped hand, deciding whether you were a stone

collectibles.name: the warm-egg minute
collectibles.text: a hand slipped under a grumbling hen, and an egg still warm

collectibles.name: the bumblebee minute
collectibles.text: a bumblebee backing out of a foxglove, dusted all over with gold

collectibles.name: the owl minute
collectibles.text: an owl calling twice across the dark fields, and another owl answering

collectibles.name: the string minute
collectibles.text: a kitten losing a long argument with a piece of string

collectibles.name: the caterpillar minute
collectibles.text: a caterpillar measuring a leaf, one careful loop at a time

collectibles.name: the velvet-nose minute
collectibles.text: a pony's velvet nose lifting an apple from a flat, brave palm
